india_trends.title: Quick Mart IPO Draws Strong Demand as Kenyan Listings Pick Up
india_trends.summary: Quick Mart Plc saw demand for shares in its initial public offering exceed the number available by almost 23% as Kenya’s second-biggest supermarket chain concluded the nation’s second IPO of the year.

india_trends.title: Deepinder Goyal's Temple gets thumbs-up from Unacademy co-founder Gaurav Munjal: ‘True potential’
india_trends.summary: Unacademy co-founder Gaurav Munjal praised Temple, Deepinder Goyal’s wearable, for its lightweight design, sleep tracking and food monitoring, saying it could become a global product made in India. He said its app’s user experience needed improvement.&nbsp;

india_trends.title: Dhanteras special: Gold beats stocks or Nifty takes the lead? Gold vs Nifty 50 returns in Samvat 2082 compared

india_trends.title: China blocks SoftBank’s $5.4 billion ABB robotics deal: How Beijing is tightening its grip on strategic technologies
india_trends.summary: China has blocked SoftBank’s $5.4 billion acquisition of ABB’s robotics business, citing concerns over strategic technology and data security. The move follows Beijing’s decision to unwind Meta’s $2 billion-plus acquisition of AI startup Manus, signalling tighter scrutiny of foreign investments.

india_trends.title: This Samvat, can large companies learn to think like entrepreneurs?
india_trends.summary: As the new Samvat begins, large companies must embrace entrepreneurial thinking, foster innovation and build the agility to respond to uncertainty rather than rely solely on budgets and forecasts
